## Description

Generates a SIVACOR-based Part B of the report from a SIVACOR TRO file (`*/tro/tro-*.jsonld`), by calling `tools/generate_sivacor_partb.sh`. By default it writes `generated/REPLICATION-PartB-SIVACOR.md` and leaves the report alone. It does not rerun author code.

[28_sivacor_partb.sh](#help-28_sivacor_partb) calls it during ingest. Running it by hand makes sense when that step left the generated Part B waiting in `generated/` because `REPLICATION-PartB.md` had already been edited.

## Usage

```bash
./automations/18_summarize_sivacor.sh [-j tro.jsonld] [-d output_dir] [-o output.md] \
    [-r report.md] [-t template.md] [--replace-report] [--dry-run]
```

- `-j`, `--jsonld` - TRO file (default: the first `*/tro/tro-*.jsonld`)
- `-d`, `--output-dir` - Output directory (default: `generated`)
- `-o`, `--output` - Output file (default: `<output_dir>/REPLICATION-PartB-SIVACOR.md`)
- `-r`, `--report` - Report to replace (default: `REPLICATION-PartB.md`)
- `-t`, `--template` - Report template (default: `REPLICATION.md`)
- `--replace-report` - Copy the result over `REPLICATION-PartB.md`; if that file does not exist, replace the Part B section of `REPLICATION.md`
- `--dry-run` - Show what would be written

### Environment Variables

- `PYTHON` - Python command to use (default: `python3`, then `python`).

See [generate_sivacor_partb.sh](#help-generate_sivacor_partb) and [get_sivacor_info.py](#help-get_sivacor_info) for what the generated Part B contains.
